meta.title: Shaded vendor fields cannot be filled by the buyer

plan.title: Buyer Cannot Edit Shaded Vendor Fields

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen, whose default stage is Auction.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Apply an auction pricing template so the template table and its locked vendor columns render.
Add a product to create a data row in the pricing sheet.
Render and populate the pricing sheet before checking cell editability.
Assert that the shaded vendor-owned fields in the first product row are read-only for the buyer.
Attempt to type into a representative shaded vendor field.
Verify the buyer's typed value is not accepted in the vendor-owned Price cell.
